messages.content: I've been feeling really anxious lately and I don't know why. What should I do?
I'm having trouble sleeping because I can't stop thinking about work. Any advice?
My friend told me they're thinking about hurting themselves. How can I help them?
I feel like I'm not good enough and everyone would be better off without me.
How do I know if I need to see a therapist or if I can handle this on my own?
I've been feeling really sad for weeks and I don't feel like doing anything anymore.
My partner and I keep arguing about the same things. How can we communicate better?
I feel overwhelmed by everything I have to do. How do I manage my stress?
Is it normal to feel this way after losing someone I love?
I want to stop drinking but I don't think I can do it alone.
